scope: Advisor decision-brief interface and bounded deterministic reasoning; no new upstream source or claim assessment

implementation.landing: Coverage-first invitation; no insufficient assessment before explicit build
implementation.brief: Established evidence, relevant unverified context, version comparisons, missing user facts, missing evidence, current conflicts, historical corrections and concrete next verification
implementation.privacy: Goal/theme-only links; optional local profiles; one-use ten-minute private Release Guide context note without changing comparison selections or choosing a target
implementation.legacy: Earlier broad ITSI, ingest-pressure and keep-current URLs retain an explicit scope/not-covered explanation without manufacturing an assessment
implementation.maintenance: Goal registry, exact dependencies, existing owners, review windows, negative release gates and prioritized conditional expansion backlog; no new schedule

evidenceBoundaries.qualification: Content identity is not upstream currency. Source checks, scoped claim/section assessments and brief creation times remain separate. Changed, overdue, missing or future-dated evidence pauses factual paths.

feedDisposition.qualification: UI and decision-model work reuses already assessed canonical claims. It does not create a new product finding or source-watch reassessment. Existing native feed history and watch declarations are preserved.

localValidation.syncAndBuild: All four required sync/check gates, Advisor adapter and maintenance gates, feed/native-feed gates and 69-asset build passed
